location_name: Spratly features claimed by Malaysia, including Amboyna Cay
summary: In early 1975, under 'Operations Terumbu' (begun after a 1974 directive to the Royal Malaysian Navy to enhance Malaysia's presence in the Spratlys), a tri-service Malaysian Armed Forces expedition (RMN, RMAF and the Army's Royal Engineer Regiment) installed sovereignty markers on Spratly features claimed by Malaysia, including Amboyna Cay.
